This achievement demonstrated net energy gain from a fusion reaction - producing more energy output than the laser energy input that drove the reaction. This was a real-world experimental result, not just a theoretical simulation, making Statement 2 incorrect. The achievement represents a significant milestone in fusion energy research, though practical fusion power generation still faces many engineering challenges beyond ignition.
